title: compare-deepseek-v4-flash
prompt: Explain in one sentence what a durable task queue is.

result.summary: A durable task queue is a system that reliably stores and processes asynchronous tasks in a persistent store (so they survive crashes or restarts), guaranteeing at-least-once execution and tracking their state until completion.

content.result: A durable task queue is a system that reliably stores and processes asynchronous tasks in a persistent store (so they survive crashes or restarts), guaranteeing at-least-once execution and tracking their state until completion.
